title: GraveVault
description: Create protected graves with double chests, holograms, and timers when players die.
body:
# GraveVault

GraveVault is a lightweight Paper plugin that creates a protected grave when a player dies.

Instead of dropping items everywhere, the player's inventory is stored inside a protected double chest with a hologram showing the owner and remaining time.

## Features

- Protected graves on death
- Double chest item storage
- Hologram with player name
- Remaining time display
- Configurable grave lifetime
- Owner-only access
- OP bypass
- English and French support
- Lightweight and easy to use

## Commands

- `/gravevault`
- `/gravevault help`
- `/gravevault language <fr|en>`
- `/gravevault time <minutes>`
- `/gravevault reload`
- `/gravevault version`

## Compatibility

- Paper 26.1.2
- Minecraft 1.21 - 1.21.8

More features will be added in future updates.
